# octodns: 23 records, origin example.com
## bind (example.com.zone, text/plain;charset=utf-8, 23 written)
; example.com as an RFC 1035 zone file (BIND), written by DomainScope from octodns.
; Records that cannot be served as they are stay here as comments, with the reason.
$ORIGIN example.com.
$TTL 3600
; No SOA record in the source: add one before a name server loads this file.
@                    300 IN A     192.0.2.10 ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
@                   3600 IN CAA   0 issue "letsencrypt.org"
@                   3600 IN MX    10 mail.example.com.
@                   3600 IN MX    20 mx2.example.net.
@                   3600 IN NS    ns1.example-dns.net.
@                   3600 IN NS    ns2.example-dns.net.
@                   3600 IN TXT   "google-site-verification=AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789"
@                   3600 IN TXT   "v=spf1 ip4:198.51.100.25 include:_spf.example.net ~all"
*                   3600 IN CNAME www.example.com.
_dmarc              3600 IN TXT   "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"
_sip._tcp            600 IN SRV   10 5 5060 sip.example.com.
admin               3600 IN A     192.0.2.12
api                  300 IN A     192.0.2.14 ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
app                 3600 IN CNAME origin-lb.example.net. ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
geo                 3600 IN A     198.51.100.30
geo                 3600 IN A     198.51.100.31
geo                 3600 IN A     198.51.100.32
geo                 3600 IN A     198.51.100.33
google._domainkey   3600 IN TXT   "v=DKIM1;k=rsa;p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexample"
intranet            3600 IN A     10.20.30.40
mail                3600 IN A     198.51.100.25
www                 3600 IN A     192.0.2.10 ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true
www                 3600 IN AAAA  2001:db8::10 ; cf_tags=cf-proxied:true

## octodns (example.com.yaml, application/yaml;charset=utf-8, 21 written)
# example.com as an octoDNS zone (example.com.yaml), written by DomainScope from octodns.
# Keys are in octoDNS order; the SOA, the apex NS and what octoDNS cannot hold are left out (see the notes).
# TXT values write ; as \; : load this file with escaped_semicolons: true on the YamlProvider (octoDNS refuses them with false, its default from 2.0).
---
'':
  - octodns:
      cloudflare:
        proxied: true
    ttl: 300
    type: A
    value: '192.0.2.10'
  - ttl: 3600
    type: CAA
    value:
      flags: 0
      tag: issue
      value: letsencrypt.org
  - ttl: 3600
    type: MX
    values:
      - exchange: mail.example.com.
        preference: 10
      - exchange: mx2.example.net.
        preference: 20
  - ttl: 3600
    type: TXT
    values:
      - 'google-site-verification=AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789'
      - 'v=spf1 ip4:198.51.100.25 include:_spf.example.net ~all'
'*':
  ttl: 3600
  type: CNAME
  value: www.example.com.
_dmarc:
  ttl: 3600
  type: TXT
  value: 'v=DMARC1\; p=quarantine\; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com'
_sip._tcp:
  ttl: 600
  type: SRV
  value:
    port: 5060
    priority: 10
    target: sip.example.com.
    weight: 5
admin:
  ttl: 3600
  type: A
  value: '192.0.2.12'
api:
  octodns:
    cloudflare:
      auto-ttl: true
      proxied: true
  ttl: 300
  type: A
  value: '192.0.2.14'
app:
  octodns:
    cloudflare:
      proxied: true
  ttl: 3600
  type: CNAME
  value: origin-lb.example.net.
geo:
  ttl: 3600
  type: A
  values:
    - '198.51.100.30'
    - '198.51.100.31'
    - '198.51.100.32'
    - '198.51.100.33'
google._domainkey:
  ttl: 3600
  type: TXT
  value: 'v=DKIM1\;k=rsa\;p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexample'
intranet:
  ttl: 3600
  type: A
  value: '10.20.30.40'
mail:
  ttl: 3600
  type: A
  value: '198.51.100.25'
www:
  - octodns:
      cloudflare:
        proxied: true
    ttl: 3600
    type: A
    value: '192.0.2.10'
  - octodns:
      cloudflare:
        proxied: true
    ttl: 3600
    type: AAAA
    value: '2001:db8::10'

## dnscontrol (dnsconfig.js, text/javascript;charset=utf-8, 21 written)
// example.com as DNSControl's dnsconfig.js, written by DomainScope from octodns.
// Read the notes DomainScope listed, then run `dnscontrol preview` before `dnscontrol push`.
var REG_NONE = NewRegistrar("none");
var DSP_MAIN = NewDnsProvider("main"); // the name of your provider's entry in creds.json

D("example.com", REG_NONE, DnsProvider(DSP_MAIN),
    DefaultTTL(3600),
    A("@", "192.0.2.10", TTL(300), CF_PROXY_ON),
    CAA("@", "issue", "letsencrypt.org"),
    MX("@", 10, "mail.example.com."),
    MX("@", 20, "mx2.example.net."),
    TXT("@", "google-site-verification=AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789"),
    TXT("@", "v=spf1 ip4:198.51.100.25 include:_spf.example.net ~all"),
    CNAME("*", "www.example.com."),
    TXT("_dmarc", "v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com"),
    SRV("_sip._tcp", 10, 5, 5060, "sip.example.com.", TTL(600)),
    A("admin", "192.0.2.12"),
    A("api", "192.0.2.14", TTL(300), CF_PROXY_ON),
    CNAME("app", "origin-lb.example.net.", CF_PROXY_ON),
    A("geo", "198.51.100.30"),
    A("geo", "198.51.100.31"),
    A("geo", "198.51.100.32"),
    A("geo", "198.51.100.33"),
    TXT("google._domainkey", "v=DKIM1;k=rsa;p=MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8AMIIBCgKCAQEAexample"),
    A("intranet", "10.20.30.40"),
    A("mail", "198.51.100.25"),
    A("www", "192.0.2.10", CF_PROXY_ON),
    AAAA("www", "2001:db8::10", CF_PROXY_ON),
END);
